capabilities: Export the first table in a reading-mode pane to a CSV file in the vault's main folder
Configure the base filename and an auto-incrementing file number
Choose the separator character and optional data quoting
Handle CR/LF characters inside cells by stripping, replacing, or marking them
Copy the generated CSV string to the clipboard
extras: Exports only the first table found in reading mode and always saves to the vault's main folder; a folder picker is planned. Tested on mobile only on iPadOS. The plugin never overwrites existing files and warns instead.
motivation: The author wanted to use table data created dynamically by the Dataview plugin in external applications like MS Power BI to build visualizations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn table data, such as Dataview query results, into a CSV file for use in external applications.

relations.evidence: I wanted to be able to further use this created data in external applications

summary: Exports the first table of a note in reading mode to a CSV file, with configurable separator, quoting and filename.
